meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 按你给的时间范围查询会议，逐场取出纪要元数据与文档链接，整理成结构化报告：单日输出「今日会议概览」，多日输出「会议纪要周报」，你要求时还可生成云文档。无纪要的会议会标注「无纪要」。
howto.when: 当你要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报，或回顾某段时间开了哪些会时触发。未指定时间范围时默认查过去 7 天。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 汇总本周会议，输出会议纪要周报
列出当天会议概览与纪要链接

say.text: 把过去一周的会议纪要汇总成一个云文档
say.note: 整理后创建云文档保存

howto.what_en: Queries your meetings over a given time range, pulls each meeting's note metadata and doc links, and produces a structured report: a daily overview or a multi-day weekly summary. On request it can create a Lark doc. Meetings without notes are marked as such.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review which meetings happened over a period. Defaults to the past 7 days if no range is given.

say_en.text: Organize this week's meeting notes for me
say_en.note: Summarizes the week into a meeting report
Lists today's meetings with note links

say_en.text: Turn last week's meeting notes into a Lark doc
say_en.note: Creates a doc with the summary
